name: Detroit Diesel Corporation Engine Plant - Redford MI

fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 1434m) landed in an east-side staging lot. Confirmed the correct facility: the very large blue/gray-roofed Detroit Diesel engine plant complex bounded by Telegraph Rd / W Outer Drive on the west and a rail line on the north. A Street View 'TRUCK ENTRANCE -> 12200 TELEGRAPH' sign and DAIMLER TRUCK building branding positively identify the site.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Clear controlled truck entrance on the SW corner off Telegraph Rd: dedicated 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' signage, a wide gated opening in tall chain-link perimeter fence with privacy screening, and a checkpoint apron set back from the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A wide blue/gray flat canopy structure spans the inbound truck lane just inside the gate (visible in Street View 2025-09 and satellite). Functions as a staffed vehicle-check canopy; a discrete free-standing booth is not separately resolvable but a world-HQ engine plant of this scale operates manned security, so guardShack=true with remoteGs=false. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Diagonally-striped truck stalls visible on the paved apron at/outside the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck artery and marked stalls inside the gate before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal truck artery from the gate runs deep north along the west yard; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and multi-lane Telegraph Rd frontage leave ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 25-50: dock doors with trailers backed in along the north building face and additional banks on the west face. Count approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers parked across the west truck yard and the NE trailer-storage rows.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity appears on two distinct building faces (north face and west face) suggesting separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus includes the main plant plus a separate DAIMLER-branded office building, an east-side ancillary building, and large support lots.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs along the north property edge with spurs/sidings fanning into the plant's north face.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Detroit metro (Redford Township), surrounded by dense residential fabric -> Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant complex + DAIMLER office building + east ancillary building + smaller support structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in the gate path; flagged uncertain.
